title: K-flat representative invariance of augmented scalar-extension Roos cones
statement:
Let $C$ be a site small in the module universe and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, with module category $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume countable products in $\mathcal A$ are exact. Let $B_{n+1}\to B_n$ for $n\ge1$ be a tower of sheaves of commutative $R$-algebras whose structure maps $R\to B_n$ commute with the transitions [def-weil-inverse-system]. No flatness or surjectivity of these ring maps is assumed. Use the unbounded derived category $D(R)$ and localization $Q$ of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], K-flat complexes with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For each such complex $P$, set $T_n(P)=P\otimes_RB_n$ with its strict transition maps, $V(P)=\prod_nT_n(P)$ termwise, and $s_P$ by $\operatorname{pr}_ns_P=t_n\operatorname{pr}_{n+1}$. Define the Roos complex by
$$L(P)^i=V(P)^i\oplus V(P)^{i-1},\qquad d(x,y)=(dx,(1-s_P)x-dy),$$
and the chain map $\eta_P:P\to L(P)$ by $p\mapsto((p\otimes1)_n,0)$.
For a quasi-isomorphism $a:P\to P'$ between K-flat complexes with flat terms, the strict map $L(a)$ obtained by applying $\prod_n(a\otimes_RB_n)$ to both coordinates is a quasi-isomorphism and satisfies $L(a)\eta_P=\eta_{P'}a$. More generally, for every isomorphism $e:Q(P)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(P')$ in $D(R)$ there is an isomorphism $v:Q(L(P))\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(L(P'))$ satisfying $v\,Q(\eta_P)=Q(\eta_{P'})e$. Consequently the condition that $\eta_P$ be a quasi-isomorphism depends only on the derived isomorphism class of $P$.

proof.text: Naturality of tensorUnit in each complex, followed by Pi.hom_ext and biprod.hom_ext, proves the strict augmentation equation. Convert independent K-flatness to categorical K-flatness in the homotopy category using the signed braiding. Resolve the coefficient module in degree zero by a K-flat complex. The tensor square, K-flatness in each variable and two-out-of-three show that tensoring a quasi-isomorphism between K-flat complexes with this arbitrary coefficient module is a quasi-isomorphism. The single-complex tensor comparison and siteSheafTensorRightIso identify it with each level map.

Exact countable products preserve the level quasi-isomorphisms, by HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_limMap. Apply lem-pe-roos-coordinates-quasi-iso with the actual products, oneSubShift, roos and roosMap; their coordinate equations hold by definition. This proves the strict Roos quasi-isomorphism.

DerivedCategory.right_fac represents e by a chain-map roof Z to P and Z to P-prime. Reflect invertibility through Q to show both legs are quasi-isomorphisms. Resolve Z by W using the independent-coefficient K-flat resolution, and convert its termwise tensor exactness to site flatness using siteSheafTensorRightIso. Apply the proved strict Roos quasi-isomorphism to the two composite legs u and b. The inverse of Q(L(u)) followed by Q(L(b)) defines v. Applying Q to strict naturality, and cancelling Q(u), proves the augmentation comparison equation.

For a supplied derived isomorphism e use the comparison v. Rewrite QuasiIso of both augmentations as IsIso of their Q-images. In the comparison equation cancel e and v to obtain both directions of the criterion.
